第2834章 飞舟之上（第1页）
“现在就进行思考，不想要加入到宗门之中的立刻就可以离开！”
他说完这句话，停顿了下来，目光在所有人的身上扫了一圈！
发现没有任何一个人有站起来的意思！
“诸位，你们确定都不打算离开么？！”
再询问了一遍之后，依旧是没有一个人开口！
“看样子，你们所有人都已经做好了迎接孤寂的准备！”
“既然如此，众位和我出来，我们一同上飞舟！”
说话之时，他站了起来，对其他两人拱了拱手。
“两位师兄，师弟我先带着这些新入门的弟子回归宗门了！”
汪泽带着林铭等人走出了宫殿，来到了宫殿之外，他右手一抬！
这飞舟迎风便涨，片刻就已经变成了十几丈大小。
这飞舟出现之后，对方这才招呼着林铭等人。
一上了飞舟，林铭顿时就发现，这飞舟比之他所想象的还要大一些！
他们十几个人上来，没有任何一点拥挤感。
从中就可以看出来，这飞舟之上，应当是有着某些禁制在身的，也正是因为这些禁制，才能够让内部的空间显现的这么大！
看到所有人都已经上来了，对方也没有任何的迟疑，当即发动了飞舟。
飞舟在皇城之中，开始一路飞驰，向上而去！

飞行之中，四周隐隐有符咒显现，却并没有力量落下来！
在这皇城之中，他们符箓宗的人有办法控制着四周的禁制阵法，让其按照他们的心意行事，该落下的时候才能够落下，不该落下的时候，就绝对不会落下。
飞舟飞出了皇城的范围，也飞出了都城。
“诸位，你们可以称呼我为汪师叔，我们修仙者达者为师，一切看双方的修为，什么时候你们的修为和我一样达到了筑基期，那个时候你们就可以称呼我为师兄了！”
“现在距离我们进入到山门，还有一段路程！”
“这段路程中，你们对宗门有什么疑问，都可以来询问我！”
“你们要根据所提出的问题，付出不同的代价！”
“你们还可以决定，你们询问的问题是不是要告诉给别人！？”
“如果你们不想要让其他人知晓，我也可以单独给你一个人回答！”
汪泽说完之后，四周几个人的眼神都是一亮。
林铭却一下子就想到了一个关键的问题，立刻开口询问着：
“师叔，若是针对一个问题，我们几个人都想要知道答案，那我们可不可以一同拿出这部分灵石来获得答案么？！”
“当然可以，只要最后的总数能够对上就可以！”

Chapter 2834 On the flying boat (page 1)
"Think about it now. If you don't want to join the sect, you can leave immediately!"
After he said this, he paused and glanced around everyone!
I found that no one had the intention to stand up!
"Everyone, are you sure you don't plan to leave?!"
After asking again, no one spoke!
"It seems that all of you are ready to face loneliness!"
"In that case, everyone, come out with me and let's get on the flying boat together!"
As he spoke, he stood up and bowed his hands to the other two.
"Two senior brothers, junior brother, I will return to the sect with these new disciples first!"
Wang Ze led Lin Ming and others out of the palace, and when they arrived outside the palace, he raised his right hand!
The flying boat swelled in the wind, and in a moment it became more than ten feet in size.
After the flying boat appeared, the other party greeted Lin Ming and others.
As soon as he got on the flying boat, Lin Ming immediately discovered that the flying boat was larger than he had imagined!
There were more than a dozen of them here, and there was no feeling of crowding at all.
It can be seen from this that there should be certain restrictions on this flying boat. It is precisely because of these restrictions that the internal space can appear so large!
Seeing that everyone had come up, the other party immediately launched the flying boat without any hesitation.
The flying boat started to fly all the way up in the imperial city!
During the flight, there were faint spells appearing all around, but there was no power to fall down!
In this imperial city, the people of Fu Lu Sect have a way to control the surrounding forbidden formations and let them act according to their wishes. They can fall when they should fall, and they will never fall when they shouldn't.
The flying boat flew out of the imperial city and also out of the capital.
"Everyone, you can call me Uncle Wang. We who are cultivators of immortality and masters are our teachers. Everything depends on the cultivation level of both parties. When your cultivation level reaches the foundation building stage like mine, then you can call me senior brother!"
"There is still some distance to go before we enter the mountain gate!"
"During this journey, if you have any questions about the sect, you can come and ask me!"
"You have to pay different prices depending on the questions you ask!"
"You can also decide whether the questions you asked should be told to others!?"
"If you don't want others to know, I can answer it for you alone!"
After Wang Ze finished speaking, the eyes of several people around him lit up.
Lin Ming suddenly thought of a key question and immediately asked:
"Uncle Master, if there is a question and several of us want to know the answer, can we take out these spiritual stones together to get the answer?!"
"Of course, as long as the final totals match up!"
